reviews.summary: No current SOL-specific external risk found: Solana’s official status page reports all systems operational with no incidents today or in the prior 7 days. The Nov. 16 Solana 1.0 announcement was a naming/protocol-versioning change, not a user asset migration or immediate network change. ([status.solana.com](https://status.solana.com/?s=09&utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Official status reports Mainnet, RPC nodes, Explorer and related services operational; no incidents are listed for November 11–17, 2026. ([status.solana.com](https://status.solana.com/?s=09&utm_source=openai))

The Solana Foundation announced Solana 1.0 on November 16, 2026; it retires the “mainnet beta” label and introduces shared protocol versioning. It states users’ SOL, accounts, apps and transaction history are unchanged. ([solana.com](https://solana.com/id/news/solana-1-0-dropping-beta-and-what-comes-next?utm_source=openai))

A scheduled staking-reward issuance event is shown for December 11, 2026, not within the immediate entry window; the cited schedule estimates 393,000 SOL weekly (about 0.07% of circulating supply). ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/unlocks/solana?utm_source=openai))
